commands.command: unit: _sha256_urn() yields the deterministic content-addressed urn:sha256 digest behind the versioned policy pin and _b64_decode/_b64url_decode round-trip real base64/base64url payloads (test_sha256_urn_and_b64_decode_are_deterministic)

unit: _tlv() parses a DER SEQUENCE TLV and _split_der_chain() splits a synthetic concatenated DER blob into its two certificates; an empty blob yields no certs so the len(chain)<2 trust fence rejects it (test_split_der_chain_and_tlv_parse_synthetic_concatenation)

positive: KeycloakIdentityProvider.authenticate() performs a real OIDC password grant against the live Keycloak token endpoint, verifies the signed access token and returns an AuthenticatedPrincipal whose principal_id is the immutable Keycloak subject, never the username (test_authenticate_real_keycloak_principal)
negative: a wrong password is rejected fail-closed by the live Keycloak password grant with IDENTITY_REJECTED, never yielding an AuthenticatedPrincipal (test_wrong_password_fails_closed)
negative: an access token whose audience does not match the expected control-plane audience is rejected fail-closed with IDENTITY_REJECTED (test_wrong_audience_fails_closed)

positive: OpaPolicyDecisionProvider.install_policy() installs a signed Rego bundle to live OPA, persists it, and returns the deterministic urn:sha256 content digest; a fresh client reads back the exact source (test_policy_install_persists_and_returns_content_digest)

positive: evaluate() returns a PERMIT PolicyDecision for a governed read whose principal, tenant, marking and action match the installed least-privilege policy, and the decision verifies against the request (test_policy_permit_for_matching_governed_input)
negative: evaluate() returns a DENY (default-deny) for a governed action not allowed by the installed policy (test_policy_deny_for_non_matching_action)

boundary propagation: the provider forwards tenant_id, organization_id, domain_id, compartments, classification_marking_ref, effective_principal_id, actor_chain, action and resource into the OPA input, and a tenant-bound policy requiring all of them returns PERMIT (test_policy_receives_all_governed_attributes)

boundary propagation: a tenant-a governed context evaluated against a tenant-b policy is denied, proving tenant_id is forwarded (not silently dropped) across the boundary (test_policy_denies_when_tenant_is_not_forwarded)
version fence: after the installed bundle drifts, evaluate() compares the verified bundle digest against the governing pin and fails closed with STALE_BUNDLE (test_stale_bundle_fails_closed)

validity window at decision time: a signed bundle valid at install but whose expiry elapses before evaluation is rejected fail-closed at decision time with POLICY_BUNDLE_WINDOW_INVALID, so no decision is ever issued against an expired bundle (test_installed_bundle_expiry_fails_closed_at_decision_time)

governed package: a signed bundle alone denies the erase action (positive control); a foreign unsigned Rego module dropped into the governed OPA package is then rejected with STALE_BUNDLE before the widened policy is ever consulted (test_unsigned_module_cannot_extend_governed_package)

positive: SpireWorkloadIdentityProvider.current() fetches the real SVID bundle from the live SPIRE agent, verifies the workload SPIFFE ID is attested, and returns a content-addressed WorkloadIdentity valid at the current instant (test_workload_identity_is_fetched_and_verified)
negative: a workload whose SPIFFE ID does not match the expected identity is rejected fail-closed with WORKLOAD_IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE (test_unexpected_spiffe_id_fails_closed)
negative: constructing a boundary provider without a mutual-TLS context is refused with MTLS_REQUIRED instead of silently downgrading to plaintext HTTP (test_provider_requires_mtls_context)

transport encryption: OpaPolicyDecisionProvider refuses an http:// base URL with MTLS_REQUIRED before any socket is opened, preserving the HTTPS+mTLS transport for policy decisions (test_opa_provider_rejects_plaintext_base_url)

transport encryption: KeycloakIdentityProvider refuses an http:// base URL with MTLS_REQUIRED before any credentialed I/O, never emitting credentials over cleartext (test_keycloak_provider_rejects_plaintext_base_url)

transport encryption: OpenBaoSecretProvider refuses an http:// base URL with MTLS_REQUIRED before any socket is opened, keeping secret material off cleartext (test_openbao_provider_rejects_plaintext_base_url)

positive: the provider-side TLS context presents a client SVID and verifies the peer chain against the SPIRE trust bundle, completing a mutual-TLS handshake that yields a parsed peer certificate (test_mtls_transport_presents_and_verifies_workload_svid)

negative: the reverse proxy requires and verifies a client certificate; a peer presenting none is rejected, proving the server enforces the mutual half of mTLS (test_mtls_server_rejects_absent_client_certificate)

positive: OpenBaoSecretProvider.lease() resolves a governed secret reference in the live OpenBao service and returns an opaque lease handle without exposing the plaintext secret to the caller (test_secret_lease_returns_opaque_handle)
negative: an unauthorized OpenBao token is rejected fail-closed with SECRETS_UNAVAILABLE and no lease is issued (test_wrong_openbao_token_fails_closed)

secret isolation: a secret_ref carrying a dot-segment path traversal is rejected fail-closed with SECRET_REFERENCE_INVALID before any OpenBao request, so a lease can never escape the authenticated principal's scope (test_secret_ref_cannot_escape_principal_scope)

fault-injection: pausing the live OPA container makes evaluate() fail closed within the bounded timeout with a correlated SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE/POLICY_UNAVAILABLE denial carrying the request correlation_id, then recover cleanly after unpause (test_paused_opa_fails_closed_within_bounded_timeout)

fault-injection: pausing the live Keycloak container makes authenticate() fail closed within the bounded timeout with SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE carrying the exact request correlation_id, then recover cleanly after unpause (test_paused_keycloak_fails_closed_with_correlation)
version fence: a request whose policy_bundle_digest pin does not match the installed content digest is denied fail-closed with STALE_BUNDLE (test_policy_pin_mismatch_fails_closed)
negative: an unsigned policy bundle (empty signature) is rejected before install with POLICY_BUNDLE_SIGNATURE_INVALID (test_unsigned_bundle_fails_closed)
negative: a tampered policy bundle whose Rego source no longer matches its signature is rejected with POLICY_BUNDLE_SIGNATURE_INVALID (test_forged_bundle_signature_fails_closed)
validity window: a signed bundle whose validity window has already expired is rejected with POLICY_BUNDLE_WINDOW_INVALID (test_expired_bundle_fails_closed)
contract typing: an OPA result that is not a boolean decision is rejected with POLICY_DECISION_INVALID instead of being converted by truthiness (test_non_boolean_policy_result_fails_closed)
negative: a governed context whose actor_chain is not bound to the authenticated principal is denied fail-closed with IDENTITY_BINDING_MISMATCH (test_forged_delegation_chain_fails_closed)

positive: a delegation signed with the real RSA signer, within scope, purpose, window and binding, verifies successfully for the authenticated delegatee (test_valid_signed_delegation_grants_within_bounds)
negative: a validly signed delegation exercised against a resource outside its scope is rejected with DELEGATION_SCOPE_MISMATCH (test_delegation_over_scope_fails_closed)
negative: a delegation exercised for a purpose outside its permitted purposes is rejected with DELEGATION_PURPOSE_MISMATCH (test_delegation_purpose_mismatch_fails_closed)
negative: a delegation bound to a different delegatee is rejected with DELEGATION_BINDING_MISMATCH (test_delegation_binding_mismatch_fails_closed)
negative: a delegation whose scopes were altered after signing fails signature verification with DELEGATION_SIGNATURE_INVALID (test_altered_delegation_fails_closed)
negative: a previously valid delegation marked revoked is rejected with DELEGATION_REVOKED (test_revoked_delegation_fails_closed)
negative: a delegation whose validity window has expired is rejected with DELEGATION_EXPIRED (test_expired_delegation_fails_closed)

VF-001 positive: _canonical_utc expresses every policy instant in UTC whole seconds, so an offset-equivalent bundle (same instant re-expressed with a +02:00 offset) yields a byte-identical signed payload, install_policy() accepts it and returns the deterministic urn:sha256 content digest (test_offset_equivalent_bundle_signing_is_stable)

VF-001 negative: reinterpreting the signed wall clock under a -02:00 offset silently moves the expiry two hours into the future; canonical UTC signing re-canonicalises the payload and rejects it with POLICY_BUNDLE_SIGNATURE_INVALID (test_offset_shifted_bundle_rejected)

VF-002 positive: OpaPolicyDecisionProvider.evaluate consumes a valid signed delegation grant on the mandatory request path against real OPA and returns a PERMIT whose PolicyDecision verifies against the request (test_valid_delegated_request_on_real_backends)

VF-002 negative: a delegated request evaluated on real OPA without the signed grant fails closed with IDENTITY_BINDING_MISMATCH instead of defaulting to permit (test_delegated_request_without_grant_fails_closed)
VF-002 negative: an expired signed delegation consumed on the mandatory request path is rejected with DELEGATION_EXPIRED (test_delegated_request_expired_fails_closed)
VF-002 negative: a signed delegation whose revocation state is configured on the provider is rejected at the boundary with DELEGATION_REVOKED (test_delegated_request_revoked_fails_closed)
VF-002 negative: a signed grant whose resource scope does not cover the requested resource is rejected with DELEGATION_SCOPE_MISMATCH (test_delegated_request_out_of_scope_fails_closed)
VF-002 negative: a signed grant whose permitted purposes exclude the request purpose is rejected with DELEGATION_PURPOSE_MISMATCH (test_delegated_request_out_of_purpose_fails_closed)

VF-002 negative: an altered actor chain (attacker delegator substituted for the delegator) on the same delegated request is rejected with DELEGATION_BINDING_MISMATCH (test_delegated_request_altered_chain_fails_closed)

negative: an absent secret reference is an outright denial with no overwrite - lease() never provisions or replaces the referenced secret material (test_absent_secret_ref_fails_closed_without_overwrite)

workload identity: the client mTLS context verifies the peer SPIFFE URI SAN and rejects a valid same-CA SVID issued to a different service at the TLS handshake (ssl.SSLError), so a foreign workload cannot complete mTLS on the same trust domain (test_client_rejects_peer_with_different_spiffe_id)

environment.backend_under_test: OPA (policy/least privilege), Keycloak (OIDC identity), SPIFFE/SPIRE (workload identity and mTLS trust), OpenBao (secret isolation) - all real, pinned, on the local ocor-bootstrap stack
environment.orchestrator: none - the boundary providers drive the real ocor-bootstrap control-plane services directly over localhost
environment.reused_deliverable: ocor_runtime.security.ports (OCOR-DEV-0014, sealed) reused unmodified; fault-injection helpers (WS-12) reused unmodified; the SPIKE counterpart OCOR-DEV-0021 proved bounded-timeout/failure semantics on the control-plane probe, this task proves the same semantics on the provider boundary itself

residual_risks: The 50 qualifying cases exercise the four real control-plane backends (OPA, Keycloak, SPIFFE/SPIRE, OpenBao) plus mTLS, signed-bundle integrity, version-fence, canonical-UTC window enforcement (VF-001), delegation grant/revocation enforcement at the policy boundary (VF-002) and fault-injection fail-closed paths. They qualify the criteria actually exercised: FR-128 (confused-deputy/delegation), FR-129 (individual identity), FR-130 (uniform versioned policy decision), FR-133 (secrets outside the ontology), FR-068 (boundary propagation), NFR-037 (fail-closed) and NFR-042 (encryption/key separation + mTLS).

The remaining requirement_ids declared on the backlog for OCOR-DEV-0048 (BR-003, BR-007, BR-013, BR-016, FR-020, FR-021, FR-067, FR-103, FR-110, FR-117, FR-143, FR-153, FR-160, NFR-010, NFR-019, NFR-026, NFR-031, NFR-049, NFR-052, NFR-056, NFR-063, NFR-064, NFR-073, NFR-074, NFR-086, NFR-087, NFR-089) are G6/G7 ledger requirements; they remain non-qualified here and are deliberately NOT attributed PASS, pending their own requirement-bound qualifying cases at G6/G7.

The two crypto unit helpers are pure deterministic functions with no external dependency; they are exercised against real concatenated DER blobs and real base64url payloads, not synthetic stubs, and no full X.509 parse is claimed by the DER case.

The plaintext-rejection cases use a monotonic guard raised before any socket is opened (no network I/O), so they are negative contract tests that prove the transport invariant without touching the live backend.
rollback_procedure_verified: Mechanical rollback review (RCCAD rollback_procedure): the change set is confined to five paths - two source/test files (ocor-runtime/src/ocor_runtime/security/control_plane.py, ocor-runtime/tests/tasks/test_ocor_dev_0048.py), two evidence files (reports/evidence/G4/OCOR-DEV-0048.json, .log) and an additive edit to reports/evidence/G4/MANIFEST.json. No migration, alembic or schema file is introduced, so versioned down/forward recovery is not applicable. The sealed reused deliverable ocor_runtime.security.ports (OCOR-DEV-0014) is untouched, verified by 'git diff origin/main...HEAD' listing exactly those five paths and no migration/*.sql/alembic file. A 'git revert' of the task commits cleanly deletes the new files and restores MANIFEST.json to its origin/main state. Control-plane state is re-seedable: OPA policy is re-installed by the test fixture, the OpenBao lease fixture removes its mount in a finally block, the Keycloak account is shared and re-seeded by the bootstrap fixture, and the temporary SPIRE entry is created and deleted within each test.
